simple.summary: יַקִּיר (yaqqîyr) means precious First listed occurrence: Jer 31 20.

definitions.full: H3357. yaqqir יַקִּיר adjective intransitive very precious, dear ; only אֶפְרַיִם לִי יַקִּיר הֲבֵן Jer 31:20 is Ephraim a very precious son unto me ? (|| שַׁעֲשׁוּעִים יֶלֶד ).
